import bioblend.galaxy

api_key = '[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]'
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

output_id = 'f9cad7b01a472135ea2b7bdc2f808e59'
content = gi.datasets.download_dataset(output_id)

# Parse tabular data
lines = content.decode('utf-8').strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0]
data = [l.split('\t') for l in lines[1:]]

animals_vals = [float(r[4]) for r in data if r[0] == 'animals' and r[5] == 'ok']
fungi_vals = [float(r[4]) for r in data if r[0] == 'fungi' and r[5] == 'ok']

import statistics
animals_median = statistics.median(animals_vals)
fungi_median = statistics.median(fungi_vals)

print(f'Animals: {len(animals_vals)} values, median = {animals_median}')
print(f'Fungi: {len(fungi_vals)} values, median = {fungi_median}')
print(f'Difference (animals - fungi): {animals_median - fungi_median}')
print(f'Difference (fungi - animals): {fungi_median - animals_median}')

# Show distribution
print(f'\nAnimals values (sorted): {sorted(animals_vals)[:20]}...')
print(f'Fungi values (sorted): {sorted(fungi_vals)[:20]}...')

# Count zeros and non-zeros
print(f'\nAnimals zeros: {sum(1 for v in animals_vals if v == 0)}')
print(f'Animals non-zeros: {sum(1 for v in animals_vals if v > 0)}')
print(f'Fungi zeros: {sum(1 for v in fungi_vals if v == 0)}')
print(f'Fungi non-zeros: {sum(1 for v in fungi_vals if v > 0)}')
"
